name: SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria)
summary: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria — the controls baseline (security, availability, confidentiality) an org demonstrates to handle customer data responsibly.

requirements.summary: Enforce least-privilege access with authentication, authorization, and review.
Encrypt data in transit (TLS) and at rest.
Log security-relevant events and protect logs from tampering.
Gate changes through review + testing before production.
Maintain an incident-response process with detection, escalation, and remediation.
Store secrets/credentials outside source control in a managed secret store.
